about_the_game:
As you soar peacefully above a vast ocean, following the path of ancient ruins, the world suddenly begins to collapse.

Thunder cracks the sky, volcanoes erupt, and flaming hail rains down from above.
And beyond all that—comes the apocalyptic fall of a star, cloaked in darkness.

Bird Like is a roguelite flight game about pushing forward through an unraveling world to reach the end—whatever it may be.

You have only one flight to survive the chaos.
Time is running out.
The most important thing is—keep going.

  • Simple, intuitive controls
    Easily control your plane with just WASD or arrow keys. Perfect for quick pick-up-and-play sessions.

  • Fly through cataclysm
    Thunderstorms, volcanic eruptions, flaming hail, collapsing ruins, and the final, starborn calamity.
    Survive increasingly intense natural disasters.

  • Five unique aircraft
    Choose from five planes, each with distinct stats and handling. Find the one that suits your playstyle best.

  • Roguelite upgrade system
    Craft your build each run with a variety of powerful upgrades and mysterious artifacts.
    Strengthen your plane and push further every time.

  • Customizable skins
    Collect and equip skins to personalize your aircraft.

  • A journey to the edge of the world
    Each session takes you deeper through ruins and storms toward an unknown destination.
    What awaits at the end? Will you make it that far?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 @3.4Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660ti (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Bird Like is a casual roguelite flight game where you soar toward destination, dodging all kinds of obstacles along the way. Pick upgrades, equip mysterious artifacts, and build your own path. What awaits at the edge of the world? Time is running out. The most important thing is—just keep going.
